emv.configuration.title: Enhanced Mob Variants
emv.configuration.spawn_mode.tooltip: Random: each mob can use any texture, so a cluster can mix variants and breeding can produce any texture. Uniform: mobs that spawn in the same group share one texture, and babies inherit that same baby texture.
